name: ModelSchema
doc: Defines properties in an input or output model / JSON object.

combo.name: CompleteModelSchema
combo.doc: Includes the declared properties in a model schema.

props.doc: ID of the API this model type belongs to.

props.name: name
props.doc:
Name of this model type (/class). Empty if unnamed. 
Named model types are often referenced from multiple sources, while unnamed types are typically single-use.

props.name: description
props.doc: Description of this model type's role / function.

name: PropertySchema
doc: Defines an individual property in a model schema.

props.name: modelTypeId
props.doc: ID of the model type that this property belongs to.

props.name: name
props.doc: Name of this property, as it should appear in the input or output model / JSON object.

props.name: contentTypeId
props.doc:
If this property contains a model/object, this is the ID of the contained model's type. 
None if this property uses some other data type.

props.name: description
props.doc: A description of this property's role/function.

props.name: isArray
props.doc:
Whether this property is an array of values. 
False if this property contains a single value. Uncertain if both are possible.

props.name: isOptional
props.doc: Whether this property may be omitted from the input and/or output.

name: AlternativePropertyType
doc: Defines an alternative supported data type for a property.

props.name: propId
props.doc: ID of the property that has this alternative type

props.name: altType
props.doc: Alternative data type supported by the linked property

name: PossiblePropertyValue
doc: Defines a possible value for an enum property

props.name: propId
props.doc: ID of the property that this value may be assigned to

props.name: value
props.doc: The value the linked property may have

props.name: description
props.doc: Description of this value's role / function
